## Power Sessions 0.1.6

Chat session details show their model, context and turns again on Orca 1.4.262.

- A chat's details show its model, effort, tokens, context and turns again. On Orca 1.4.262 they showed only the agent name.
- Chat sessions keep the order of Orca's sidebar again.
- Orca 1.4.262 moved the file the plugin reads chats from. Older Orca builds keep working.
